verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is documented only as a CLI (git, dir, stdin commands), a pre-commit hook and a GitHub Action, and all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404. The Action's calls to a GitHub API are a host-platform capability, not a Gitleaks API. A CLI is an adjacent interface, not a documented public API, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
